title: Master Employee

purpose.en: The register of all employees: identity, job position, family, education, contracts, bank account and discipline log. Open it to register a new hire or to update an existing employee's data.
purpose.id: Daftar seluruh karyawan: identitas, posisi kerja, keluarga, pendidikan, kontrak, rekening bank dan catatan kedisiplinan. Buka untuk mendaftarkan karyawan baru atau memperbarui data karyawan yang ada.

keywords: karyawan, pegawai, employee, master employee, data karyawan, nik, ktp, kontrak kerja, keluarga, rekening, registrasi karyawan, hr

steps.en: In the grid, search by name, code, NIK or position, or click a status box or filter (Department, Position, Work Status, Pay Frequency) to narrow the list.
steps.id: Di grid, cari berdasarkan nama, kode, NIK atau posisi, atau klik kotak status atau filter (Department, Position, Work Status, Pay Frequency) untuk menyaring daftar.

steps.en: Click + New Record to register a new employee, or open a row to edit one. The employee code is created by the system.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk mendaftarkan karyawan baru, atau buka satu baris untuk mengubahnya. Kode karyawan dibuat otomatis oleh sistem.

steps.en: Fill the Profile tab and the Job tab, then click Save. The other tabs only work after the first save.
steps.id: Isi tab Profile dan tab Job, lalu klik Save. Tab lainnya baru bisa dipakai setelah data disimpan sekali.

steps.en: After the first save, add family members, education, contracts and the salary bank account in their tabs.
steps.id: Setelah disimpan pertama kali, tambahkan anggota keluarga, pendidikan, kontrak dan rekening gaji di tab masing-masing.

steps.en: When the strict mandatory switch is on, the Family tab must hold Ayah, Ibu, Mertua Ayah and Mertua Ibu before you can leave a newly registered employee.
steps.id: Bila saklar field wajib (strict) menyala, tab Family harus berisi Ayah, Ibu, Mertua Ayah dan Mertua Ibu sebelum Anda keluar dari karyawan yang baru didaftarkan.

steps.en: For a new employee a login card is shown once after saving. Print it or pass the login details to the employee, because it will not be shown again.
steps.id: Untuk karyawan baru, kartu login muncul satu kali setelah disimpan. Cetak atau berikan data login ke karyawan, karena tidak akan ditampilkan lagi.

steps.en: To stop an employee from appearing in payroll and attendance lists, untick Active (or use the activate toggle in the grid) instead of deleting the record.
steps.id: Agar karyawan tidak muncul di daftar gaji dan presensi, hilangkan centang Active (atau pakai tombol aktif di grid) dan jangan menghapus data.

fields.label: Full name
fields.en: Full name of the employee, typed as on the KTP. Always required.
fields.id: Nama lengkap karyawan, diketik sesuai KTP. Selalu wajib diisi.

fields.label: Nickname
fields.en: Nickname, optional.
fields.id: Nama panggilan, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Gender
fields.en: Laki-laki or Perempuan. Required when the strict mandatory switch is on.
fields.id: Laki-laki atau Perempuan. Wajib bila saklar field wajib (strict) menyala.

fields.label: Religion
fields.en: Pick from the list (Islam, Kristen, Katolik, Hindu, Buddha, Konghucu, Lainnya). Optional.
fields.id: Pilih dari daftar (Islam, Kristen, Katolik, Hindu, Buddha, Konghucu, Lainnya). Boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Birth place
fields.en: City of birth, typed. Optional.
fields.id: Kota kelahiran, diketik. Boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Birth date (as on KTP)
fields.en: Birth date as on the KTP. The employee must be at least 17 years old, otherwise saving is refused.
fields.id: Tanggal lahir sesuai KTP. Karyawan minimal berusia 17 tahun, bila kurang data tidak bisa disimpan.

fields.label: NIK KTP
fields.en: National ID number, exactly 16 digits. Used for identity checks and payroll tax data.
fields.id: Nomor NIK KTP, tepat 16 digit angka. Dipakai untuk pengecekan identitas dan data pajak gaji.

fields.label: Family card (KK) no.
fields.en: Family card number, typed.
fields.id: Nomor Kartu Family, diketik.

fields.label: Tax ID (NPWP)
fields.en: Tax number, optional.
fields.id: Nomor NPWP, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Mobile / WhatsApp (main)
fields.en: Main mobile number. It is used to recover the employee's account and as the WhatsApp address for payslips. Employees without it show in the Without WhatsApp Number report.
fields.id: Nomor HP utama. Dipakai untuk memulihkan akun karyawan dan sebagai alamat WhatsApp slip gaji. Karyawan tanpa nomor ini muncul di laporan Karyawan Tanpa No. WhatsApp.

fields.label: Personal email
fields.en: Personal email. Required for a new registration when the strict mandatory switch is on.
fields.id: Email pribadi. Wajib untuk registrasi baru bila saklar field wajib (strict) menyala.

fields.label: KTP address
fields.en: Address as on the KTP, optional.
fields.id: Alamat sesuai KTP, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Residence address
fields.en: Current living address. Required when the strict switch is on.
fields.id: Alamat tempat tinggal sekarang. Wajib bila saklar strict menyala.

fields.label: Join date
fields.en: Date the employee joined the company.
fields.id: Date karyawan mulai bekerja di perusahaan.

fields.label: Work Status
fields.en: Bekerja (working), Dirumahkan (furloughed) or Cuti (on leave). It appears as Work Status in the grid.
fields.id: Bekerja, Dirumahkan atau Cuti. Tampil sebagai Work Status di grid.

fields.label: Work status since
fields.en: Date the current work status started, optional.
fields.id: Date status kerja saat ini mulai berlaku, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Name
fields.en: Emergency contact name (Kontak Darurat section).
fields.id: Nama kontak darurat (bagian Kontak Darurat).

fields.label: Relation
fields.en: Relationship of the emergency contact to the employee. In the family dialog the same label is a list of relations (Suami, Istri, Anak, Ayah, Ibu, Mertua Ayah, Mertua Ibu).
fields.id: Relation kontak darurat dengan karyawan. Di dialog keluarga, label yang sama berupa daftar hubungan (Suami, Istri, Anak, Ayah, Ibu, Mertua Ayah, Mertua Ibu).

fields.label: Phone
fields.en: Phone number of the emergency contact.
fields.id: Nomor telepon kontak darurat.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Tick for a current employee. Untick when the employee leaves; the record stays in the system.
fields.id: Centang untuk karyawan yang masih bekerja. Hilangkan centang bila karyawan keluar; datanya tetap tersimpan.

fields.label: Position (department — position)
fields.en: Pick the position from Position Master, shown as Department and Position. Required when the strict switch is on. It decides department, reporting line and some access rules.
fields.id: Pilih posisi dari Master Posisi, tampil sebagai Departemen dan Posisi. Wajib bila saklar strict menyala. Menentukan departemen, atasan dan sebagian aturan akses.

fields.label: Default machine
fields.en: Optional default machine. It only pre-fills scheduling and does not lock any assignment.
fields.id: Mesin bawaan, boleh dikosongkan. Hanya mengisi awal jadwal dan tidak mengunci penugasan.

fields.label: Default shift
fields.en: Optional default shift. It only pre-fills the shift roster and does not lock any assignment.
fields.id: Shift bawaan, boleh dikosongkan. Hanya mengisi awal roster shift dan tidak mengunci penugasan.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Education tab: kind of activity (Sertifikasi, Seminar, Pelatihan, Pendidikan Formal). Contract dialog: employment type (Tetap, Kontrak, Harian, Borongan).
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: jenis kegiatan (Sertifikasi, Seminar, Pelatihan, Pendidikan Formal). Dialog kontrak: jenis kerja (Tetap, Kontrak, Harian, Borongan).

fields.label: Activity
fields.en: Education tab: name of the course, certificate or school. Required.
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: nama kursus, sertifikat atau sekolah. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Organizer
fields.en: Education tab: organizer or institution, optional.
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: penyelenggara atau lembaga, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Education tab: date of the activity. Required.
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: tanggal kegiatan. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Cost
fields.en: Education tab: cost of the activity, 0 or more.
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: biaya kegiatan, 0 atau lebih.

fields.label: Funded by
fields.en: Education tab: who paid (Perusahaan, Pribadi or Sharing).
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: siapa yang membayar (Perusahaan, Pribadi atau Sharing).

fields.label: Service bond
fields.en: Education tab: tick when the employee is bound to stay with the company after this activity.
fields.id: Tab Pendidikan: centang bila karyawan terikat dinas setelah kegiatan ini.

fields.label: Full name *
fields.en: Family dialog: full name of the family member. Ayah, Ibu, Mertua Ayah and Mertua Ibu can only be added once each; at most 20 children.
fields.id: Dialog keluarga: nama lengkap anggota keluarga. Ayah, Ibu, Mertua Ayah dan Mertua Ibu masing-masing hanya sekali; anak maksimal 20.

fields.label: Birth date
fields.en: Family dialog: birth date of the family member, optional.
fields.id: Dialog keluarga: tanggal lahir anggota keluarga, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: NIK
fields.en: Family dialog: NIK of the family member, optional.
fields.id: Dialog keluarga: NIK anggota keluarga, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Salary type
fields.en: Contract dialog: salary basis (Per Bulan, Per Hari, Per Unit). Saving a new contract closes the previous active contract automatically.
fields.id: Dialog kontrak: dasar gaji (Per Bulan, Per Hari, Per Unit). Menyimpan kontrak baru otomatis menutup kontrak aktif sebelumnya.

fields.label: Start
fields.en: Contract dialog: contract start date. Required.
fields.id: Dialog kontrak: tanggal mulai kontrak. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: End date
fields.en: Contract dialog: end date, left empty for a permanent contract. Must be after the start date.
fields.id: Dialog kontrak: tanggal selesai, kosongkan untuk karyawan tetap. Harus setelah tanggal mulai.

fields.label: Salary amount *
fields.en: Contract dialog: salary amount of the contract. The amount is confidential and visible only to authorised users.
fields.id: Dialog kontrak: nominal gaji kontrak. Nilainya rahasia dan hanya terlihat oleh user yang berwenang.

fields.label: Probation period
fields.en: Contract dialog: tick when the contract starts with a probation period. Then Probation Selesai becomes required.
fields.id: Dialog kontrak: centang bila kontrak diawali masa percobaan. Setelah itu Probation Selesai wajib diisi.

fields.label: Bank
fields.en: Bank tab: the bank of the salary account, picked from Supplier Master category BANK. Leave on Cash / Tunai when the employee is paid in cash.
fields.id: Tab Rekening Bank: bank rekening gaji, dipilih dari Master Supplier kategori BANK. Biarkan Cash / Tunai bila karyawan dibayar tunai.

fields.label: Account no.
fields.en: Bank tab: account number, required once a bank is chosen.
fields.id: Tab Rekening Bank: nomor rekening, wajib bila bank dipilih.

fields.label: Account holder
fields.en: Bank tab: account holder name, required once a bank is chosen. Click Save in this tab to store the bank account.
fields.id: Tab Rekening Bank: nama pemilik rekening, wajib bila bank dipilih. Klik Save di tab ini untuk menyimpan rekening.

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: Discipline tab: reason of the discipline record. Use Add Record, choose a type (Verbal warning, SP1, SP2, SP3, Alpha) and the incident date.
fields.id: Tab Discipline: alasan catatan kedisiplinan. Pakai Add Record, pilih tipe (Verbal warning, SP1, SP2, SP3, Alpha) dan tanggal kejadian.

title: Employee Data Correction

purpose.en: HR review of correction requests that employees send from Self-Service when their own data is wrong. Open it to approve or reject the pending requests.
purpose.id: Tempat HR menilai pengajuan koreksi data yang dikirim karyawan lewat Self-Service saat data dirinya salah. Buka untuk menyetujui atau menolak pengajuan yang menunggu.

keywords: koreksi data, correction, ajukan koreksi, ubah data karyawan, self service, approval koreksi, tolak koreksi

steps.en: Open the screen. Waiting requests are listed first. Use the status boxes or the Field and Status filters to narrow the list.
steps.id: Buka layar ini. Pengajuan yang menunggu tampil paling atas. Pakai kotak status atau filter Field dan Status untuk menyaring.

steps.en: Read the field, the old value, the new value and the reason of the request.
steps.id: Baca nama field, nilai lama, nilai baru dan alasan pengajuan.

steps.en: Open the request and click Approve if the new value is correct.
steps.id: Buka pengajuan lalu klik Approve bila nilai barunya benar.

steps.en: Approving applies the new value to the employee automatically for Tanggal Lahir, NIK KTP, Telepon / WA, Alamat KTP, Alamat Domisili, Kontak Darurat and the payroll bank account (hidden; needs the payroll right).
steps.id: Persetujuan langsung mengubah data karyawan untuk Tanggal Lahir, NIK KTP, Telepon / WA, Alamat KTP, Alamat Domisili, Kontak Darurat dan rekening bank gaji (disembunyikan; butuh hak payroll).

steps.en: For any other field, approving only closes the request. HR must then change the data in Master Employee by hand.
steps.id: Untuk field lain, persetujuan hanya menutup pengajuan. HR harus mengubah datanya sendiri di Master Employee.

steps.en: To refuse, click Reject, type the reason and confirm. The employee gets a notification with the reason and can submit again.
steps.id: Untuk menolak, klik Reject, tulis alasannya lalu konfirmasi. Karyawan menerima notifikasi berisi alasan dan bisa mengajukan ulang.

fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.en: Required when rejecting. Explain why; the employee receives this text as a notification.
fields.id: Wajib saat menolak. Jelaskan alasannya; teks ini diterima karyawan sebagai notifikasi.

fields.label: Approve
fields.en: Action on a waiting request. Approves it and applies the new value when the field is one of those that update automatically.
fields.id: Aksi pada pengajuan yang menunggu. Menyetujui dan menerapkan nilai baru bila field-nya termasuk yang berubah otomatis.

fields.label: Reject
fields.en: Action on a waiting request. Opens the dialog to type the rejection reason.
fields.id: Aksi pada pengajuan yang menunggu. Membuka dialog untuk menulis alasan penolakan.

title: Department

purpose.en: The list of departments chosen in Master Position, Purchase Requisition, Shift, Roster and Stock Out. Open it to add a department, rename it or switch it off.
purpose.id: Daftar departemen yang dipilih di Master Posisi, Purchase Requisition, Shift, Roster dan Stock Out. Buka untuk menambah departemen, mengganti namanya atau menonaktifkannya.

keywords: department, departemen, bagian, divisi, struktur organisasi, org department, unit kerja, lookup departemen

steps.en: Open Department. Each row is one department and is edited directly in the cell.
steps.id: Buka Department. Tiap baris adalah satu departemen dan diedit langsung di selnya.

steps.en: Click Row to add a new line, then type the Code and the Department Name.
steps.id: Klik Row untuk menambah baris baru, lalu ketik Code dan Department Name.

steps.en: Pick the Division the department belongs to, or leave it empty when the department serves all divisions.
steps.id: Pilih Division tempat departemen itu berada, atau kosongkan bila departemen melayani semua divisi.

steps.en: Click Save. All changed rows are saved together; if one row is wrong nothing is saved and the message names the row. Undo drops the unsaved changes.
steps.id: Klik Save. Semua baris yang berubah disimpan bersamaan; bila satu baris salah, tidak ada yang tersimpan dan pesan menyebut barisnya. Undo membuang perubahan yang belum disimpan.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Unique code, up to 20 characters, always capital letters. Required. A saved code cannot be changed because programs and documents refer to it.
fields.id: Kode unik, maksimal 20 karakter, selalu huruf besar. Wajib. Kode yang sudah disimpan tidak bisa diganti karena dirujuk program dan dokumen.

fields.label: Department Name
fields.en: Name shown in every department list, up to 150 characters. Required.
fields.id: Nama yang tampil di semua daftar departemen, maksimal 150 karakter. Wajib.

fields.label: Division
fields.en: The division the department belongs to, picked from the division list. Optional.
fields.id: Divisi tempat departemen itu berada, dipilih dari daftar divisi. Boleh kosong.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Untick to stop offering the department in the lists. Rows are not deleted, only switched off.
fields.id: Hilangkan centang supaya departemen tidak ditawarkan lagi di daftar pilihan. Baris tidak dihapus, hanya dinonaktifkan.

title: Position Master

purpose.en: The list of job positions with their department, level and who they report to. Open it when a new position is created or the reporting line changes. The organization chart is drawn from this data.
purpose.id: Daftar posisi kerja beserta departemen, level dan atasannya. Buka saat ada posisi baru atau garis pelaporan berubah. Bagan struktur organisasi digambar dari data ini.

keywords: posisi, jabatan, position, master posisi, level, melapor ke, struktur organisasi, org chart, job description, deskripsi kerja

steps.en: Search by position name, code or department, or filter by Department and Level.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan nama posisi, kode atau departemen, atau saring berdasarkan Department dan Level.

steps.en: Click + New Record, or open a row to edit it.
steps.id: Klik + New Record, atau buka satu baris untuk mengubahnya.

steps.en: Fill Code, Name, Level and Department. These four are required.
steps.id: Isi Code, Name, Level dan Department. Keempatnya wajib.

steps.en: Pick Reports to to set the boss position. A position cannot report to one of its own subordinates; the system refuses that loop.
steps.id: Pilih Reports to untuk menentukan posisi atasan. Posisi tidak boleh melapor ke bawahannya sendiri; sistem menolak putaran itu.

steps.en: Click Save. To retire a position, use the activate toggle in the grid instead of deleting it.
steps.id: Klik Save. Untuk menonaktifkan posisi, pakai tombol aktif di grid dan jangan menghapusnya.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Short unique code of the position, typed. Required.
fields.id: Kode singkat posisi yang unik, diketik. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Level
fields.en: Organization level picked from the active levels. Required.
fields.id: Level organisasi, dipilih dari daftar level aktif. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Name
fields.en: Name of the position, shown in Master Employee and on the organization chart. Required.
fields.id: Nama posisi, tampil di Master Employee dan bagan organisasi. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Department
fields.en: Department the position belongs to, picked from active departments. Required.
fields.id: Department tempat posisi berada, dipilih dari departemen aktif. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Reports To
fields.en: The position this one reports to. Leave empty for the top position. It builds the organization chart.
fields.id: Posisi atasan langsung. Kosongkan untuk posisi puncak. Dipakai untuk membangun bagan organisasi.

fields.label: Job description
fields.en: Job description for everyone holding this position. Only HR Officers see and edit this field; employees read it in Self-Service.
fields.id: Deskripsi kerja untuk semua pemegang posisi ini. Hanya HR Officer yang melihat dan mengubahnya; karyawan membacanya di Self-Service.

title: SOP & Work Instruction

purpose.en: The register of SOP and Work Instruction documents. HR Officers add and edit them; everyone else only reads, including the Maintenance team. Approved documents are read in Self-Service and listed on the opening dashboard.
purpose.id: Daftar dokumen SOP dan Instruksi Kerja. HR Officer menambah dan mengubahnya; yang lain hanya membaca, termasuk tim Maintenance. Dokumen Approved dibaca di Self-Service dan tampil di dashboard pembuka.

keywords: sop, standard operating procedure, prosedur, dokumen sop, nomor dokumen, revisi sop, aturan kerja, work instruction, instruksi kerja, wi, petunjuk kerja, jenis dokumen

steps.en: Search by document code or title, or filter by Document Type (SOP or Work Instruction) and Department.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan kode atau judul dokumen, atau saring berdasarkan Document Type (SOP atau Work Instruction) dan Department.

steps.en: Open a row. If you are not an HR Officer you see the SOP read-only and there is nothing to save.
steps.id: Buka satu baris. Bila Anda bukan HR Officer, SOP tampil hanya-baca dan tidak ada yang bisa disimpan.

steps.en: HR Officer: click + New Record, fill Document No., pick the Document Type, fill SOP Title, and add Purpose and the Steps (one row per step, with a section name; Add line adds a row).
steps.id: HR Officer: klik + New Record, isi Document No., pilih Document Type, isi SOP Title, lalu tambahkan Purpose dan Steps (satu baris per langkah, dengan nama bagian; Add line menambah baris).

steps.en: Set Revision, Effective From and Department Scope, then click Save. A new document is a Draft; click Approve to show it to employees (it is then locked). Back to Draft reopens it: the revision goes up and employees stop seeing it until you Approve again.
steps.id: Atur Revision, Effective From dan Department Scope, lalu klik Save. Dokumen baru berstatus Draft; klik Approve agar tampil untuk karyawan (lalu terkunci). Back to Draft membukanya lagi: revisi naik dan karyawan tidak melihatnya sampai Anda Approve lagi.

steps.en: To stop showing an old SOP, open it and click Deactivate (Activate shows it again). Only approved, active documents reach employees.
steps.id: Untuk berhenti menampilkan SOP lama, buka dokumennya lalu klik Deactivate (Activate menampilkannya lagi). Hanya dokumen Approved yang aktif yang sampai ke karyawan.

fields.label: Document No.
fields.en: Unique SOP document number, typed, for example 001/SOP/TM/V/2026. Required.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen SOP yang unik, diketik, misalnya 001/SOP/TM/V/2026. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Revision
fields.en: Revision number of the document (00, 01, ...). It goes up by itself on Back to Draft. Required.
fields.id: Nomor revisi dokumen (00, 01, ...). Naik sendiri saat Back to Draft. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.en: SOP for a procedure across steps or departments; Work Instruction for how to do one job at one machine or station. Picked, required. It decides in which list the document appears on the opening dashboard.
fields.id: SOP untuk prosedur lintas langkah atau departemen; Work Instruction untuk cara mengerjakan satu pekerjaan di satu mesin atau pos. Dipilih, wajib. Menentukan di daftar mana dokumen tampil di dashboard pembuka.

fields.label: SOP Title
fields.en: Title of the document. Required.
fields.id: Judul dokumen. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Effective
fields.en: Effective date of this revision, optional.
fields.id: Tanggal berlaku revisi ini, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Department Scope
fields.en: Department the SOP applies to. Leave on All Departments when it applies to everyone.
fields.id: Departemen yang memakai SOP ini. Biarkan Semua Departemen bila berlaku untuk semua.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.en: Purpose of the SOP, free text, optional.
fields.id: Purpose SOP, teks bebas, boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Steps
fields.en: The steps of the document, one row per step with a section name. Employees see them in this order.
fields.id: Langkah-langkah dokumen, satu baris per langkah dengan nama bagian. Karyawan melihatnya dalam urutan ini.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Tick to keep the SOP visible to employees.
fields.id: Centang agar SOP tetap tampil untuk karyawan.

title: Attendance

purpose.en: Daily attendance per employee calculated from fingerprint and mobile clock-in. Open it to check the days, recalculate a date range or correct a status by hand with an audit reason.
purpose.id: Presensi harian per karyawan hasil hitungan dari finger dan clock-in HP. Buka untuk mengecek hari kerja, menghitung ulang rentang tanggal atau mengoreksi status secara manual dengan alasan audit.

keywords: presensi, absensi, attendance, finger, hadir, telat, terlambat, alpha, lembur, override status, hitung ulang presensi

steps.en: The grid shows the last 60 days. Use the status boxes (Present, Late, Absent) or the Status and Source filters to narrow it.
steps.id: Grid menampilkan 60 hari terakhir. Pakai kotak status (Present, Late, Absent) atau filter Status dan Source untuk menyaring.

steps.en: Open a row to see that day in detail: shift, clock in and out, late, early leave, overtime, the calculated status and the source (Automatic or Manual).
steps.id: Buka sebuah baris untuk melihat hari itu secara rinci: shift, jam masuk dan keluar, terlambat, pulang awal, lembur, status hasil hitung dan sumbernya (Otomatis atau Manual).

steps.en: To correct the day, pick the New status and write the Audit reason (at least 10 characters, for example the FDT form number), then click Save.
steps.id: Untuk mengoreksi hari itu, pilih New status dan tulis Audit reason (minimal 10 karakter, misalnya nomor formulir FDT), lalu klik Save.

steps.en: The row is then marked Manual and your name and reason stay as the audit trail. A manual status is kept when attendance is recalculated.
steps.id: Baris lalu bertanda Manual dan nama serta alasan Anda tersimpan sebagai jejak audit. Status manual dipertahankan saat presensi dihitung ulang.

steps.en: Click Recalculate this day to release the override and recalculate that day from the fingerprint scans.
steps.id: Klik Recalculate this day untuk melepas override dan menghitung ulang hari itu dari scan finger.

steps.en: To recalculate many days, open Upload Attendance, use the card Recalculate Attendance, choose From date and To date (up to 92 days) and confirm; all active employees are recalculated.
steps.id: Untuk menghitung ulang banyak hari, buka Upload Attendance, pakai kartu Recalculate Attendance, pilih From date dan To date (maks 92 hari) lalu konfirmasi; semua pegawai aktif dihitung ulang.

fields.label: From Date
fields.en: First date of the range shown and recalculated. Starts on this week's Monday.
fields.id: Tanggal awal rentang yang ditampilkan dan dihitung ulang. Awalnya Senin minggu ini.

fields.label: To Date
fields.en: Last date of the range. Starts on today.
fields.id: Tanggal akhir rentang. Awalnya hari ini.

fields.label: Search Employee Name/Code
fields.en: Search box to find an employee by name or employee code.
fields.id: Kotak cari untuk menemukan karyawan berdasarkan nama atau kode karyawan.

fields.label: New Status
fields.en: New attendance status for the day. Examples: Present (H), Telat (T-5, T+5, T+15), Izin (I), Izin Disetujui (IS), Sakit (S). Others: Cuti (C), Cuti Melahirkan (CL), Alpha (A), Tidak Finger (F, FF).
fields.id: Status presensi baru untuk hari itu. Contoh: Present (H), Telat (T-5, T+5, T+15), Izin (I), Izin Disetujui (IS), Sakit (S). Lainnya: Cuti (C), Cuti Melahirkan (CL), Alpha (A), Tidak Finger (F, FF).

fields.label: Audit Trail Reason (Min 10 Characters) *
fields.en: Required reason for the manual change, at least 10 characters. It is kept with your name for audit.
fields.id: Alasan wajib untuk perubahan manual, minimal 10 karakter. Disimpan bersama nama Anda untuk audit.

title: Leave Approval

purpose.en: HR approval of leave, sick and permission requests that employees submit in Self-Service. Open it to approve or reject the waiting requests.
purpose.id: Persetujuan HR untuk pengajuan cuti, sakit dan izin yang dikirim karyawan di Self-Service. Buka untuk menyetujui atau menolak pengajuan yang menunggu.

keywords: cuti, sakit, izin, leave, approval cuti, pengajuan cuti, saldo cuti, cuti khusus, surat dokter, setujui, tolak

steps.en: Open the screen. Waiting requests are listed first. Filter by Type or Status, or click a status box.
steps.id: Buka layar ini. Pengajuan yang menunggu tampil paling atas. Saring berdasarkan Type atau Status, atau klik kotak status.

steps.en: Check the type, the dates and number of days, the reason and the attachments (Surat Cuti, Surat Dokter, Kwitansi/Resep, Screenshot JKN, Attachments). The form also shows the leave balance of that year: remaining now and after approve.
steps.id: Cek jenis, tanggal dan jumlah hari, alasan dan lampiran (Surat Cuti, Surat Dokter, Kwitansi/Resep, Screenshot JKN, Attachments). Form juga menampilkan saldo cuti tahun itu: sisa sekarang dan setelah Approve.

steps.en: Click Approve to approve. For normal leave (Cuti) the days are added to the employee's used leave; sick and permission requests do not touch the leave balance.
steps.id: Klik Approve untuk menyetujui. Untuk cuti biasa (Cuti) jumlah hari ditambahkan ke cuti terpakai; sakit dan izin tidak mengurangi saldo cuti.

steps.en: To refuse, click Reject, type the reason and confirm.
steps.id: Untuk menolak, klik Reject, tulis alasannya lalu konfirmasi.

steps.en: The employee receives a notification of the decision in both cases.
steps.id: Karyawan menerima notifikasi keputusan, baik disetujui maupun ditolak.

fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.en: Required when rejecting a request, up to 255 characters. The employee sees it in the notification.
fields.id: Wajib saat menolak pengajuan, maksimal 255 karakter. Karyawan melihatnya di notifikasi.

fields.label: Approve
fields.en: Approves the waiting request. If the request deducts leave balance, the used days of that year increase by the requested days.
fields.id: Menyetujui pengajuan yang menunggu. Bila pengajuan memotong saldo cuti, cuti terpakai tahun itu bertambah sesuai jumlah hari.

fields.label: Reject
fields.en: Opens the dialog to type the rejection reason and rejects the request.
fields.id: Membuka dialog untuk menulis alasan penolakan lalu menolak pengajuan.

title: GPS Location Approval

purpose.en: HR approval of mobile clock-in or clock-out taken outside the allowed radius. Until HR approves, that clock record does not count for attendance.
purpose.id: Persetujuan HR untuk clock-in atau clock-out lewat HP yang dilakukan di luar radius yang diizinkan. Sebelum disetujui HR, catatan itu tidak dihitung sebagai presensi.

keywords: gps, lokasi, clock in, clock out, radius, geofence, absen hp, mobile, approval lokasi, luar radius

steps.en: Open the screen. Waiting items are listed first; the grid shows the date, time, type, distance in meters and whether it was inside or outside the radius.
steps.id: Buka layar ini. Data yang menunggu tampil paling atas; grid menunjukkan tanggal, jam, jenis, jarak dalam meter dan apakah di dalam atau di luar radius.

steps.en: Filter by Type, Radius or Status if you need to find a record.
steps.id: Saring berdasarkan Type, Radius atau Status bila perlu mencari satu catatan.

steps.en: Open a waiting record to see the clock details (time, coordinates, distance). Click Approve if the location is acceptable: the clock is written as attendance data and that day is recalculated.
steps.id: Buka catatan yang menunggu untuk melihat rincian clock (waktu, koordinat, jarak). Klik Approve bila lokasinya dapat diterima: clock masuk sebagai data presensi dan hari itu dihitung ulang.

steps.en: To refuse, click Reject and type the reason (up to 255 characters). The record does not count for attendance. A decision is final; Approve and Reject only appear while the record is Waiting.
steps.id: Untuk menolak, klik Reject dan tulis alasannya (maks 255 karakter). Catatan itu tidak dihitung sebagai presensi. Keputusan bersifat final; Approve dan Reject hanya muncul selama catatan masih Waiting.

fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.en: Required when rejecting. Explain why the location is not accepted.
fields.id: Wajib saat menolak. Jelaskan mengapa lokasi tidak diterima.

fields.label: Approve
fields.en: Approves the waiting record, creates the clock entry and recalculates that employee's attendance for the day.
fields.id: Menyetujui catatan yang menunggu, membuat data clock dan menghitung ulang presensi karyawan itu pada hari tersebut.

fields.label: Reject
fields.en: Opens the dialog to type the reason and rejects the record.
fields.id: Membuka dialog untuk menulis alasan lalu menolak catatan.

title: Salary & Tax Master

purpose.en: Sets the salary components and tax switches of each active employee. Payroll calculation reads these settings. The amounts are confidential and only authorised users can open the edit form.
purpose.id: Mengatur komponen gaji dan saklar pajak tiap karyawan aktif. Perhitungan gaji membaca pengaturan ini. Nominalnya rahasia dan hanya user berwenang yang bisa membuka form ubah.

keywords: gaji, salary, gaji pokok, tunjangan, ptkp, pph21, bpjs, pajak, master gaji, bonus pagi, bonus hadir, rate gaji

steps.en: Search by name or employee code, or use the status boxes (Not set, BPJS active, PPh21 active) and the PTKP and Salary Setup filters.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan nama atau kode karyawan, atau pakai kotak status (Not set, BPJS active, PPh21 active) dan filter PTKP serta Salary Setup.

steps.en: Find employees marked Not set. Payroll marks them as anomalies until a salary is set.
steps.id: Cari karyawan berstatus Not set. Perhitungan gaji menandai mereka sebagai anomali sampai gajinya diatur.

steps.en: Click Atur Gaji & Pajak on the row. You need payroll authority; HR Officers without it cannot open it, except for security guards.
steps.id: Klik Atur Gaji & Pajak pada baris. Anda perlu hak payroll; HR Officer tanpa hak itu tidak bisa membukanya, kecuali untuk satpam.

steps.en: Fill the salary components, choose the PTKP status and tick the BPJS and PPh21 switches that apply.
steps.id: Isi komponen gaji, pilih status PTKP dan centang saklar BPJS serta PPh21 yang berlaku.

steps.en: Click Save. The old setting is closed with an end date and a new one is created, so the salary history is kept.
steps.id: Klik Save. Pengaturan lama ditutup dengan tanggal akhir dan dibuat yang baru, sehingga riwayat gaji tetap tersimpan.

fields.label: Base Salary / Month (IDR) *
fields.en: Monthly base salary. Required, 0 or more. Confidential.
fields.id: Gaji pokok per bulan. Wajib, 0 atau lebih. Rahasia.

fields.label: Skill Allowance / Month (IDR)
fields.en: Monthly skill allowance. Default 0.
fields.id: Tunjangan keahlian per bulan. Bawaan 0.

fields.label: Loyalty Allowance / Month (IDR)
fields.en: Monthly loyalty allowance. Default 0.
fields.id: Tunjangan loyalitas per bulan. Bawaan 0.

fields.label: Performance Allowance / Month (IDR)
fields.en: Monthly performance allowance. Default 0.
fields.id: Tunjangan prestasi per bulan. Bawaan 0.

fields.label: Morning Bonus / Day (IDR)
fields.en: Daily early-arrival bonus amount. Default 0.
fields.id: Nominal bonus datang pagi per hari. Bawaan 0.

fields.label: Attendance Bonus / Day (IDR)
fields.en: Daily attendance bonus amount. Default 0.
fields.id: Nominal bonus hadir per hari. Bawaan 0.

fields.label: PTKP Status (required when PPh21 is enabled)
fields.en: Non-taxable income status, from TK/0 to K/3. Required when Potong PPh21 is ticked.
fields.id: Status PTKP, dari TK/0 sampai K/3. Wajib bila Potong PPh21 dicentang.

fields.label: Deduct BPJS (JHT/JP/Kes)
fields.en: Tick to deduct BPJS for this employee in payroll. Off by default; HR switches it on per employee.
fields.id: Centang untuk memotong BPJS karyawan ini di perhitungan gaji. Awalnya mati; HR menyalakannya per karyawan.

fields.label: Deduct PPh21 (TER)
fields.en: Tick to deduct income tax PPh21 (TER method) for this employee. Off by default.
fields.id: Centang untuk memotong PPh21 (metode TER) karyawan ini. Awalnya mati.

title: Employee Bank Accounts

purpose.en: Sets how each active employee receives salary: bank transfer to the primary account, or cash. Payroll splits the bank and cash lists from this data.
purpose.id: Menentukan cara tiap karyawan aktif menerima gaji: transfer ke rekening utama, atau tunai. Perhitungan gaji memisahkan daftar bank dan tunai dari data ini.

keywords: rekening, bank, transfer gaji, tunai, cash, nomor rekening, atas nama, metode gaji, rekening karyawan

steps.en: Search by NIK, name or code, or filter by Department, Salary Method or Bank. The status boxes count Transfer and Cash.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan NIK, nama atau kode, atau saring berdasarkan Department, Salary Method atau Bank. Kotak status menghitung Transfer dan Cash.

steps.en: Open the employee row: the Master Employee form opens on its Bank tab. Only people with the payroll right see the list and the tab (Direksi: everyone; HR Officer: Non-staff only).
steps.id: Buka baris karyawan: form Master Employee terbuka di tab Bank. Hanya yang berhak payroll yang melihat daftar dan tab ini (Direksi: semua; HR Officer: hanya Non-staff).

steps.en: Pick the Bank, then fill Account No. and Account Holder.
steps.id: Pilih Bank, lalu isi Account No. dan Account Holder.

steps.en: To pay in cash, clear the bank selection. The old account is deactivated.
steps.id: Untuk dibayar tunai, kosongkan pilihan bank. Rekening lama dinonaktifkan.

steps.en: Click Save on the employee form. The bank account is saved together with the rest of the employee data.
steps.id: Klik Save di form pegawai. Rekening bank tersimpan bersama data pegawai lainnya.

fields.label: Bank
fields.en: Bank of the salary account, picked from Supplier Master category BANK. Leave empty (Cash / Tunai) for cash payment. New banks are added in Supplier Master.
fields.id: Bank rekening gaji, dipilih dari Master Supplier kategori BANK. Kosongkan (Cash / Tunai) untuk gaji tunai. Bank baru ditambahkan di Master Supplier.

fields.label: Account No.
fields.en: Account number, up to 50 characters. Required when a bank is chosen.
fields.id: Nomor rekening, maksimal 50 karakter. Wajib bila bank dipilih.

fields.label: Account Holder
fields.en: Name of the account holder, up to 150 characters. Required when a bank is chosen.
fields.id: Nama pemilik rekening, maksimal 150 karakter. Wajib bila bank dipilih.

title: Payroll Calculation

purpose.en: Runs the payroll for a weekly or monthly period and moves it through Draft, Calculated, Verified, Confirmed, Paid and Closed. Open it each pay period.
purpose.id: Menjalankan perhitungan gaji untuk periode mingguan atau bulanan dan memprosesnya lewat Draft, Calculated, Verified, Confirmed, Paid dan Closed. Buka setiap periode gaji.

keywords: payroll, gaji, hitung gaji, perhitungan gaji, periode gaji, kalkulasi, verifikasi, konfirmasi, tutup periode, anomali, batch run

steps.en: Choose Bulanan (monthly) or Mingguan (weekly). Only active employees with that pay frequency are calculated.
steps.id: Pilih Bulanan atau Mingguan. Hanya karyawan aktif dengan frekuensi gaji itu yang dihitung.

steps.en: Set the period start and end dates, or pick an existing period in Select Period, then click Run Calculation. You can recalculate while the status is Draft or Calculated.
steps.id: Atur tanggal awal dan akhir periode, atau pilih periode yang ada di Select Period, lalu klik Run Calculation. Hitung ulang bisa selama status Draft atau Calculated.

steps.en: Read the summary (people and totals for bank and cash). A warning shows employees with no active salary setting; fix them in Salary & Tax Master and recalculate.
steps.id: Baca ringkasannya (jumlah orang dan total bank serta tunai). Peringatan menunjukkan karyawan tanpa pengaturan gaji aktif; perbaiki di Master Gaji & Pajak lalu hitung ulang.

steps.en: Click Verify Attendance, choose to check everyone (FULL) or a random sample, then Confirm Checked.
steps.id: Klik Verify Attendance, pilih cek semua pegawai (FULL) atau sampel acak, lalu Confirm Checked.

steps.en: Click Confirm (Kunci Presensi). It is refused while anomalies remain. After this, attendance is locked and the period cannot be recalculated.
steps.id: Klik Confirm (Kunci Presensi). Ditolak selama masih ada anomali. Setelah ini presensi terkunci dan periode tidak bisa dihitung ulang.

steps.en: After the transfer and cash payment is done outside the system, click Mark as Paid.
steps.id: Setelah transfer dan pembayaran tunai dilakukan di luar sistem, klik Mark as Paid.

steps.en: Optionally click Mark Payslips as Sent, then Close Period. The next period is created automatically as Draft.
steps.id: Bila perlu klik Mark Payslips as Sent, lalu Close Period. Periode berikutnya dibuat otomatis berstatus Draft.

fields.label: Monthly
fields.en: Switch to monthly periods.
fields.id: Beralih ke periode bulanan.

fields.label: Weekly
fields.en: Switch to weekly periods.
fields.id: Beralih ke periode mingguan.

fields.label: Select Period
fields.en: List of existing periods of the chosen type with their status. Picks which period you work on.
fields.id: Daftar periode yang sudah ada untuk jenis terpilih beserta statusnya. Menentukan periode mana yang dikerjakan.

fields.label: Run Calculation
fields.en: Calculates base salary, allowances, overtime, bread money, BPJS and PPh21 (when switched on) and fines from the attendance of the period. Creates the payslips.
fields.id: Menghitung gaji pokok, tunjangan, lembur, uang roti, BPJS dan PPh21 (bila aktif) serta denda dari presensi periode. Slip gaji dibuat.

fields.label: Verify Attendance
fields.en: HR check of clock-in and clock-out times: FULL checks all employees, RANDOM_SAMPLE checks a random sample. Needs status Calculated.
fields.id: Pengecekan HR atas jam masuk dan keluar: FULL untuk semua pegawai, RANDOM_SAMPLE untuk sampel acak. Perlu status Calculated.

fields.label: Confirm (Lock Attendance)
fields.en: Locks attendance for the period. Needs status Verified and no payslip anomalies.
fields.id: Mengunci presensi periode. Perlu status Verified dan tidak ada anomali slip.

fields.label: Mark as Paid
fields.en: Records that the bank transfer and cash payment were executed. Needs status Confirmed.
fields.id: Mencatat bahwa transfer bank dan pembayaran tunai sudah dilakukan. Perlu status Confirmed.

fields.label: Mark Payslips as Sent
fields.en: Records the time the payslips were distributed. Available when the period is Paid.
fields.id: Mencatat waktu slip gaji dibagikan. Tersedia saat periode berstatus Paid.

fields.label: Close Period
fields.en: Closes a Paid period and creates the next empty period.
fields.id: Menutup periode yang sudah Paid dan membuat periode berikutnya yang masih kosong.

title: Print & Send Payslips

purpose.en: The place to print payslips of a calculated period and to choose which slips go to print or WhatsApp. Slips are created by Payroll Calculation, not here.
purpose.id: Tempat mencetak slip gaji periode yang sudah dihitung dan memilih slip mana yang dicetak atau dikirim lewat WhatsApp. Slip dibuat oleh Perhitungan Gaji, bukan di sini.

keywords: slip gaji, payslip, cetak slip, kirim slip, whatsapp, wa, print slip, gaji bersih, anomali slip

steps.en: Pick the period in the period list. Only periods already calculated are offered.
steps.id: Pilih periode di daftar periode. Hanya periode yang sudah dihitung yang tersedia.

steps.en: Search by employee name or code, or use the status boxes (Not printed, WhatsApp not sent, Anomaly).
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan nama atau kode karyawan, atau pakai kotak status (Not printed, WhatsApp not sent, Anomaly).

steps.en: Tick or untick the Printout and Kirim WA marks per slip. WhatsApp can only be ticked when the employee has a phone number.
steps.id: Centang atau hilangkan centang Printout dan Kirim WA pada tiap slip. WhatsApp hanya bisa dicentang bila karyawan punya nomor HP.

steps.en: Click Print All to print all slips that are ticked for printing and have no anomaly. The button shows how many.
steps.id: Klik Print All untuk mencetak semua slip yang dicentang cetak dan tanpa anomali. Tombol menunjukkan jumlahnya.

steps.en: Or open one row to print that single slip. Opening a slip stamps its print time.
steps.id: Atau buka satu baris untuk mencetak slip itu saja. Membuka slip mencatat waktu cetaknya.

steps.en: Slips with an anomaly (no active salary setting) cannot be printed. Fix them in Salary & Tax Master and recalculate the period.
steps.id: Slip yang anomali (tanpa pengaturan gaji aktif) tidak bisa dicetak. Perbaiki di Master Gaji & Pajak lalu hitung ulang periodenya.

fields.label: Period
fields.en: Selects the payroll period whose slips are listed.
fields.id: Memilih periode gaji yang slipnya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Printout
fields.en: Tick to include the slip when printing all. The time it was printed appears under the tick once the slip was opened or printed.
fields.id: Centang agar slip ikut saat cetak semua. Waktu cetaknya tampil di bawah centang setelah slip dibuka atau dicetak.

fields.label: Send WhatsApp
fields.en: Tick to mark the slip for WhatsApp. Disabled when the employee has no phone number. The WhatsApp channel itself is not built yet; Send All via WhatsApp is disabled.
fields.id: Centang untuk menandai slip dikirim lewat WhatsApp. Nonaktif bila karyawan tak punya nomor HP. Kanal WhatsApp-nya belum dibangun; Send All via WhatsApp dinonaktifkan.

fields.label: Print All
fields.en: Opens the print of every slip of the period that is ticked for printing and has no anomaly.
fields.id: Membuka cetakan semua slip periode yang dicentang cetak dan tanpa anomali.

title: Manpower Requisition

purpose.en: A department asks for new staff here. The request goes through the approval steps of its recruitment track. Only an approved requisition can be turned into a job vacancy.
purpose.id: Departemen meminta tenaga kerja baru di sini. Permohonan melewati langkah approval sesuai track rekrutmennya. Hanya permohonan yang disetujui yang bisa dijadikan lowongan.

keywords: permohonan tenaga kerja, requisition, manpower, mpr, kebutuhan karyawan, rekrutmen, headcount, ajukan approval, tambah karyawan

steps.en: Click + New Record. A draft requisition with a number like RCR26 plus five digits is created and opened.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Draft permohonan dengan nomor seperti RCR26 plus lima digit dibuat dan dibuka.

steps.en: Fill Track, Department, Position Needed, Headcount, Qualification and Requisition Reason. Changes are saved as you leave each field while the status is Draft.
steps.id: Isi Track, Department, Position Needed, Headcount, Qualification dan Requisition Reason. Perubahan tersimpan saat Anda meninggalkan tiap kolom selama status Draft.

steps.en: Click Submit for Approval. Position, qualification and reason must be filled. The approval steps of the track are created.
steps.id: Klik Submit for Approval. Posisi, kualifikasi dan alasan harus terisi. Langkah approval sesuai track dibuat.

steps.en: The approver of the current step sees Approval Decision. They add a Notes and click Approve or Reject; Reject needs a note.
steps.id: Approver pada langkah berjalan melihat Approval Decision. Ia mengisi Notes lalu klik Approve atau Reject; Reject wajib memakai catatan.

steps.en: When all steps are approved the status becomes Approved. A rejection makes it Rejected. A Draft can be removed with Delete.
steps.id: Bila semua langkah disetujui, status menjadi Approved. Bila ditolak, menjadi Rejected. Draft dapat dihapus dengan Delete.

fields.label: Track
fields.en: Recruitment track, picked from the active tracks. It decides the approval steps and the candidate pipeline stages. Required.
fields.id: Track rekrutmen, dipilih dari track aktif. Menentukan langkah approval dan tahap pipeline kandidat. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Department
fields.en: Department that needs the staff, picked from active departments. It also decides who approves. Required.
fields.id: Department yang membutuhkan tenaga kerja, dipilih dari departemen aktif. Juga menentukan siapa yang menyetujui. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Position Needed
fields.en: Free-text name of the position needed. Required to submit.
fields.id: Nama posisi yang dibutuhkan, teks bebas. Wajib untuk mengajukan.

fields.label: Headcount
fields.en: Number of people needed, at least 1.
fields.id: Jumlah orang yang dibutuhkan, minimal 1.

fields.label: Qualification
fields.en: Required qualifications of the candidates. Required to submit.
fields.id: Kualifikasi yang dibutuhkan dari kandidat. Wajib untuk mengajukan.

fields.label: Requisition Reason
fields.en: Why the staff is needed, such as replacement or expansion. Required to submit.
fields.id: Alasan butuh tenaga kerja, misalnya pengganti atau penambahan. Wajib untuk mengajukan.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Note of the approver. Optional when approving, required when rejecting.
fields.id: Catatan approver. Boleh kosong saat menyetujui, wajib saat menolak.

title: Vacancy Posting

purpose.en: Publishes a job vacancy from an approved requisition and shows how many applicants each posting received. Open it to post a new vacancy or to close one.
purpose.id: Memasang lowongan dari permohonan yang sudah disetujui dan menunjukkan jumlah pelamar tiap lowongan. Buka untuk memasang lowongan baru atau menutupnya.

keywords: lowongan, vacancy, posting lowongan, channel, jobstreet, linkedin, publish, tutup lowongan, pelamar, loker

steps.en: Click + New Record to open the Vacancy Form.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk membuka Vacancy Form.

steps.en: Search and choose an approved Requisition (the Vacancy title is filled from the position), pick a Channel (including Glints), and type the Public description.
steps.id: Cari dan pilih Requisition yang sudah disetujui (judul lowongan terisi dari posisinya), pilih Channel (termasuk Glints), dan tulis Public description.

steps.en: Click Save. Saving publishes the vacancy to the careers portal at once; the code is VAC26 plus five digits.
steps.id: Klik Save. Menyimpan langsung menerbitkan lowongan ke portal karir; kodenya VAC26 plus lima digit.

steps.en: Open a row to read the vacancy and see how many people applied through it. An existing vacancy is read-only.
steps.id: Buka sebuah baris untuk membaca lowongan dan melihat berapa orang yang melamar. Lowongan yang ada bersifat baca-saja.

steps.en: To close a vacancy click Close vacancy on its form and confirm. Candidates can no longer apply afterwards.
steps.id: Untuk menutup lowongan klik Close vacancy di formnya lalu konfirmasi. Kandidat tidak bisa melamar lagi sesudahnya.

fields.label: Requisition
fields.en: Approved manpower requisition this vacancy is for. Only requisitions with status Approved are offered. Required.
fields.id: Permohonan tenaga kerja yang disetujui untuk lowongan ini. Hanya permohonan berstatus Approved yang tersedia. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Channel
fields.en: Where the vacancy is posted: Portal Sendiri, Jobstreet, LinkedIn, Referral or Lainnya.
fields.id: Tempat lowongan dipasang: Portal Sendiri, Jobstreet, LinkedIn, Referral atau Lainnya.

fields.label: Vacancy Title
fields.en: Public title of the vacancy, for example Operator Cetak Offset. Required.
fields.id: Judul lowongan untuk publik, misalnya Operator Cetak Offset. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Public Description
fields.en: Public description candidates read about the job. Optional.
fields.id: Deskripsi pekerjaan yang dibaca kandidat. Boleh dikosongkan.

title: Candidate Application Review

purpose.en: Read-only view of the full candidate form of one application, to review before deciding. Applications arrive from the candidate portal; nobody types them here.
purpose.id: Tampilan hanya-baca formulir lengkap kandidat untuk satu lamaran, untuk ditinjau sebelum memutuskan. Lamaran masuk dari portal kandidat; tidak diketik di sini.

keywords: review kandidat, formulir kandidat, lamaran, pelamar, candidate, application, data calon karyawan, cv, screening

steps.en: In the grid, search by candidate or vacancy, or use the status boxes and the Vacancy and Status filters.
steps.id: Di grid, cari berdasarkan kandidat atau lowongan, atau pakai kotak status dan filter Vacancy serta Status.

steps.en: Open a row to read the whole form, from personal data to documents. The top shows the status and the current pipeline stage.
steps.id: Buka satu baris untuk membaca seluruh formulir, dari data pribadi sampai dokumen. Bagian atas menampilkan status dan tahap pipeline saat ini.

steps.en: Nothing is saved on this screen. Use Back to return to the grid.
steps.id: Tidak ada yang disimpan di layar ini. Pakai Back untuk kembali ke grid.

steps.en: Decide in the Pipeline Board: move the candidate to the next stage, reject or withdraw the application.
steps.id: Putuskan di Pipeline Board: pindahkan kandidat ke tahap berikutnya, tolak atau tarik lamaran.

fields.label: 1. Data Pribadi
fields.en: Name, nickname, national ID, gender, religion, email, phone, birth date, addresses, vehicle and driving licence types, marital status.
fields.id: Nama, panggilan, NIK, jenis kelamin, agama, email, telepon, tanggal lahir, alamat, jenis kendaraan dan SIM, status perkawinan.

fields.label: 2. Data Keluarga
fields.en: Family members of the candidate.
fields.id: Anggota keluarga kandidat.

fields.label: 3. Riwayat Pendidikan
fields.en: Formal education and non-formal courses.
fields.id: Pendidikan formal dan kursus nonformal.

fields.label: 4. Pengalaman Organisasi
fields.en: Organization experience of the candidate.
fields.id: Pengalaman organisasi kandidat.

fields.label: 5. Pengalaman Kerja
fields.en: Work history, latest first, with positions and dates.
fields.id: Riwayat kerja, terbaru dulu, dengan posisi dan tanggal.

fields.label: 6. Aktivitas Sosial, Kegiatan & Referensi
fields.en: Hobbies, leisure, acquaintances in the company, emergency contacts and professional references.
fields.id: Hobi, kegiatan luang, kenalan di perusahaan, kontak darurat dan referensi profesional.

fields.label: 7. Minat & Konsep Pribadi
fields.en: The candidate's own answers: reasons to join, expectations, work preferences, strengths and weaknesses.
fields.id: Jawaban kandidat sendiri: alasan bergabung, harapan, preferensi kerja, kekuatan dan kelemahan.

fields.label: 8. Riwayat Kesehatan
fields.en: Height, weight, blood type, illness and hospital history, smoking, disability.
fields.id: Tinggi, berat, golongan darah, riwayat sakit dan rawat inap, merokok, disabilitas.

fields.label: 9. Bahasa, Komputer & Info Lowongan
fields.en: Language and computer skills, source of vacancy information, expected salary and facilities, availability date.
fields.id: Kemampuan bahasa dan komputer, sumber info lowongan, gaji dan fasilitas yang diharapkan, tanggal siap bekerja.

fields.label: 10. Kesediaan & Pernyataan
fields.en: Willingness checklist, agreement and the signature name of the candidate.
fields.id: Daftar kesediaan, persetujuan dan nama tanda tangan kandidat.

fields.label: 11. Dokumen
fields.en: Documents uploaded by the candidate.
fields.id: Dokumen yang diunggah kandidat.

title: Interview Schedule

purpose.en: Schedule HR and user interviews for candidates who reached an interview stage, and mark interviews done or cancelled.
purpose.id: Menjadwalkan interview HR dan user bagi kandidat yang sudah sampai tahap interview, serta menandai interview selesai atau batal.

keywords: jadwal interview, interview, wawancara, kalender, interviewer, hr interview, user interview, jadwalkan kandidat

steps.en: The grid lists all interview schedules. Click + New Record to schedule a candidate, or open a row to read its schedule.
steps.id: Grid menampilkan semua jadwal interview. Klik + New Record untuk menjadwalkan kandidat, atau buka baris untuk membaca jadwalnya.

steps.en: Search and choose the application waiting to be scheduled. Only candidates in an Interview stage without a scheduled interview are listed; the stage comes from the application.
steps.id: Cari dan pilih lamaran yang menunggu jadwal. Hanya kandidat di tahap Interview tanpa jadwal yang tampil; tahap diambil dari lamaran.

steps.en: Pick the Interviewer, the Date (not in the past), the Time and optionally the Location (up to 150 characters).
steps.id: Pilih Interviewer, Date (tidak boleh lampau), Time dan Location bila perlu (maksimal 150 karakter).

steps.en: Click Save. The interview is scheduled and the interviewer gets a notification with a link to the schedule.
steps.id: Klik Save. Interview terjadwal dan interviewer menerima notifikasi berisi tautan ke jadwal.

steps.en: After the interview open the schedule and click Mark Done, or Cancel schedule if it will not happen. Only a scheduled interview can be changed.
steps.id: Setelah interview buka jadwalnya lalu klik Mark Done, atau Cancel schedule bila batal. Hanya jadwal yang masih scheduled yang bisa diubah.

steps.en: Then enter the result of the interview in Assessment Result so the candidate can move to the next stage.
steps.id: Lalu isi hasil interview di Assessment Result supaya kandidat bisa maju ke tahap berikutnya.

fields.label: Application waiting to be scheduled
fields.en: The application to schedule. Only IN_PROGRESS applications in an Interview stage without a scheduled interview are listed. Required.
fields.id: Lamaran yang dijadwalkan. Hanya lamaran IN_PROGRESS di tahap Interview tanpa jadwal yang tampil. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Interviewer
fields.en: The active user who will interview the candidate. Required; gets a notification.
fields.id: User aktif yang akan mewawancarai kandidat. Wajib diisi; menerima notifikasi.

fields.label: Date and Time
fields.en: When the interview takes place. The date cannot be in the past. Required.
fields.id: Kapan interview berlangsung. Tanggal tidak boleh lampau. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Location
fields.en: Place of the interview, for example HR Meeting Room. Optional, up to 150 characters.
fields.id: Tempat interview, misalnya Ruang Meeting HR. Boleh dikosongkan, maksimal 150 karakter.

title: Assessment Results

purpose.en: Record the result of psychological tests and interviews. A candidate cannot move on in the Pipeline Board from these stages until a result is entered.
purpose.id: Mencatat hasil psikotes dan interview. Kandidat tidak bisa maju di Pipeline Board dari tahap ini sebelum hasilnya diisi.

keywords: hasil psikotes, assessment, hasil interview, penilaian kandidat, skor, rekomendasi, lanjut, tidak lanjut

steps.en: Click + New Record to open the Assessment Result Form.
steps.id: Klik + New Record untuk membuka Assessment Result Form.

steps.en: Search and choose the application awaiting a result. The list only shows candidates in a Psikotes or Interview stage that still have no result; the stage comes from the application.
steps.id: Cari dan pilih lamaran yang menunggu hasil. Daftar hanya berisi kandidat di tahap Psikotes atau Interview yang belum punya hasil; tahap diambil dari lamaran.

steps.en: Choose a Recommendation, type the Score (0 to 100) if there is one and write the Notes. The note is required.
steps.id: Pilih Recommendation, ketik Score (0 sampai 100) bila ada dan tulis Notes. Notes wajib diisi.

steps.en: Click Save. Your user is stored as the assessor. Now the candidate can be moved to the next stage in the Pipeline Board. A saved result cannot be changed.
steps.id: Klik Save. User Anda tersimpan sebagai penilai. Sekarang kandidat bisa dipindah ke tahap berikutnya di Pipeline Board. Hasil yang sudah disimpan tidak bisa diubah.

steps.en: Use the grid to look back at results, filtered by Stage, Recommendation or Assessor. Open a row to read the full result.
steps.id: Pakai grid untuk melihat hasil sebelumnya, disaring berdasarkan Stage, Recommendation atau Assessor. Buka baris untuk membaca hasil lengkap.

fields.label: Application awaiting result
fields.en: The application to record. Only IN_PROGRESS applications in a test or interview stage without a result are listed. Required.
fields.id: Lamaran yang dicatat. Hanya lamaran IN_PROGRESS di tahap tes atau interview yang belum punya hasil yang tampil. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Score
fields.en: Test or interview score from 0 to 100, may have decimals. Optional.
fields.id: Skor tes atau interview dari 0 sampai 100, boleh berdesimal. Boleh dikosongkan.

fields.label: Recommendation
fields.en: Assessor's advice: Proceed, Do Not Proceed or Consider. Required.
fields.id: Saran penilai: Proceed, Do Not Proceed atau Consider. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Notes
fields.en: Assessor's notes explaining the result. Required.
fields.id: Catatan penilai yang menjelaskan hasil. Wajib diisi.

title: Offering

purpose.en: Prepare a job offer for a candidate in the offering stage, get it approved, send it and record the candidate's answer. Salary figures are not shown in the grid.
purpose.id: Menyiapkan penawaran kerja untuk kandidat di tahap offering, memintakan persetujuan, mengirimkannya dan mencatat jawaban kandidat. Nilai gaji tidak ditampilkan di grid.

keywords: offering, offer, penawaran kerja, offer letter, gaji diusulkan, terima offer, tolak offer, revisi offer, kontrak

steps.en: In the grid, find the candidate (applications in the offering stage or that already have an offer). Open the row.
steps.id: Di grid, cari kandidatnya (lamaran di tahap offering atau yang sudah punya penawaran). Open barisnya.

steps.en: Opening a first time creates a Draft offer with start date 14 days ahead and contract type Tetap. Fill Proposed Salary, Contract Type and Start Date.
steps.id: Pembukaan pertama membuat penawaran Draft dengan tanggal mulai 14 hari ke depan dan jenis kontrak Tetap. Isi Proposed Salary, Contract Type dan Start Date.

steps.en: Click Submit for Approval. The proposed salary must be above zero. The approvers of the track decide with Approve or Reject.
steps.id: Klik Submit for Approval. Gaji diusulkan harus lebih dari nol. Approver pada track memutuskan dengan Approve atau Reject.

steps.en: When approved, click Send to Candidate. When the candidate answers, click Candidate Accepted or Candidate Declined. The answer is entered by hand.
steps.id: Bila disetujui, klik Send to Candidate. Saat kandidat menjawab, klik Candidate Accepted atau Candidate Declined. Jawaban diinput manual.

steps.en: A declined offer can be redone with Revise Offer, which creates a new draft copy. An accepted offer goes on to Hire Provisioning.
steps.id: Penawaran yang ditolak bisa diulang dengan Revise Offer, yang membuat salinan draft baru. Penawaran yang diterima dilanjutkan ke Provision to ERP.

fields.label: Proposed Salary
fields.en: Proposed salary for the candidate. Must be above zero to submit. Confidential; it also becomes the contract salary when the candidate is provisioned.
fields.id: Gaji yang diusulkan untuk kandidat. Harus lebih dari nol untuk diajukan. Rahasia; juga menjadi gaji kontrak saat kandidat diprovision.

fields.label: Contract Type
fields.en: Tetap, Kontrak, Harian or Borongan. It becomes the contract type of the new employee.
fields.id: Tetap, Kontrak, Harian atau Borongan. Menjadi jenis kontrak karyawan baru.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.en: Date the candidate starts work. It becomes the join date of the new employee.
fields.id: Tanggal kandidat mulai bekerja. Menjadi tanggal bergabung karyawan baru.

fields.label: Submit for Approval
fields.en: Sends the Draft offer to the approvers of the recruitment track. The fields are locked after that.
fields.id: Mengirim penawaran Draft ke approver pada track rekrutmen. Setelah itu kolom terkunci.

fields.label: Send to Candidate
fields.en: Marks an approved offer as Sent.
fields.id: Menandai penawaran yang disetujui sebagai Sent.

fields.label: Revise Offer
fields.en: On a declined offer, creates a new draft with the same values to adjust and submit again.
fields.id: Pada penawaran yang ditolak, membuat draft baru dengan nilai yang sama untuk disesuaikan dan diajukan lagi.

title: Provision to ERP

purpose.en: Turns a candidate who accepted the offer into a real employee with a contract and a login account. Do this once, after the offer is accepted.
purpose.id: Mengubah kandidat yang menerima penawaran menjadi karyawan sungguhan lengkap dengan kontrak dan akun login. Lakukan sekali, setelah penawaran diterima.

keywords: provisioning, provision, karyawan baru, hire, diterima, buat karyawan, akun login, kandidat jadi karyawan, onboarding

steps.en: The grid lists applications whose offer was accepted (status Waiting) and those already done. Open a Waiting row to see the Hire Provisioning Form.
steps.id: Grid menampilkan lamaran yang penawarannya diterima (status Waiting) dan yang sudah selesai. Buka baris Waiting untuk melihat Hire Provisioning Form.

steps.en: Pick the Position of the new employee. Positions of the requisition's department are listed first. The salary from the offer is copied by the system and not shown.
steps.id: Pilih Position karyawan baru. Posisi dari departemen pada permohonan ditampilkan lebih dulu. Gaji dari penawaran disalin sistem dan tidak ditampilkan.

steps.en: Click Provision to ERP and confirm. This cannot be undone. Only users with payroll rights can do it.
steps.id: Klik Provision to ERP lalu konfirmasi. Ini tidak bisa dibatalkan. Hanya user yang berhak payroll yang bisa.

steps.en: The system creates the employee from the candidate data, a contract from the offer, copies the candidate documents and creates a login, all in one go. The application becomes Hired.
steps.id: Sistem membuat karyawan dari data kandidat, kontrak dari penawaran, menyalin dokumen kandidat dan membuat login, sekaligus. Lamaran menjadi Hired.

steps.en: You land on Master Employee with the login card. The login and password are shown once; give them to the new employee by hand, then click Close.
steps.id: Anda masuk ke Master Employee dengan kartu login. Login dan password ditampilkan satu kali; berikan ke karyawan baru secara langsung, lalu klik Close.

steps.en: Provisioning is refused if an employee with the same National ID already works here. Afterwards complete the missing data in Master Employee, such as family and bank account.
steps.id: Provisioning ditolak bila karyawan dengan No. KTP yang sama masih bekerja di sini. Setelah itu lengkapi data yang kurang di Master Employee, seperti keluarga dan rekening bank.

fields.label: Position
fields.en: Position of the new employee, picked from active positions in Position Master. Required. The requisition only holds a free-text title, so HR confirms the real position here.
fields.id: Posisi karyawan baru, dipilih dari posisi aktif di Master Posisi. Wajib diisi. Permohonan hanya berisi judul teks bebas, jadi HR menentukan posisi sebenarnya di sini.

fields.label: Provision to ERP
fields.en: Creates the employee, contract and login for the chosen application in one transaction. Blocked if the application was already provisioned.
fields.id: Membuat karyawan, kontrak dan login untuk lamaran terpilih dalam satu transaksi. Ditolak bila lamaran sudah pernah diprovision.

title: Talent Pool

purpose.en: All candidates who ever applied, with their application history. Use it to find a known candidate again and invite them to a new vacancy without filling the form again.
purpose.id: Semua kandidat yang pernah melamar beserta riwayat lamarannya. Pakai untuk menemukan kandidat lama dan mengundangnya ke lowongan baru tanpa mengisi formulir lagi.

keywords: talent pool, kandidat, pelamar lama, undang ke lowongan, riwayat lamaran, database kandidat, cari kandidat

steps.en: In the grid, search by candidate name, phone or vacancy, or filter by Last Vacancy and Last Status.
steps.id: Di grid, cari berdasarkan nama kandidat, telepon atau lowongan, atau saring berdasarkan Last Vacancy dan Last Status.

steps.en: Click the expand control on a row to see all applications of that candidate: vacancy, applied date, stage and status.
steps.id: Klik tombol perluas pada baris untuk melihat semua lamaran kandidat itu: lowongan, tanggal melamar, tahap dan status.

steps.en: Open the row to go to the Talent Pool Form. It shows the candidate (read-only) and the full application history.
steps.id: Buka baris untuk masuk ke Talent Pool Form. Isinya data kandidat (baca-saja) dan seluruh riwayat lamaran.

steps.en: In the card Invite to vacancy search and choose an open vacancy, then click Invite to vacancy. A new application is created at stage 1 with status Applied.
steps.id: Di kartu Invite to vacancy cari dan pilih lowongan terbuka, lalu klik Invite to vacancy. Lamaran baru dibuat di tahap 1 berstatus Applied.

steps.en: A closed vacancy, or one where the candidate already has an active application, is refused. New candidates cannot be typed in here; they come from the candidate portal.
steps.id: Lowongan yang sudah ditutup, atau yang sudah punya lamaran aktif dari kandidat itu, ditolak. Kandidat baru tidak bisa diketik di sini; mereka datang dari portal kandidat.

fields.label: Vacancy
fields.en: The open vacancy to invite the candidate to. Only vacancies that are published and not closed are listed. Required.
fields.id: Lowongan terbuka tujuan undangan. Hanya lowongan yang dipublikasikan dan belum ditutup yang tampil. Wajib diisi.

fields.label: Invite to vacancy
fields.en: Creates a new application for the candidate on the chosen vacancy, so no data needs to be entered again.
fields.id: Membuat lamaran baru untuk kandidat pada lowongan terpilih, sehingga data tidak perlu diisi ulang.

title: Employees Without WhatsApp Number

purpose.en: Lists active employees whose mobile number is empty. Those employees cannot recover their own account and cannot receive payslips by WhatsApp. HR uses it as a to-do list.
purpose.id: Menampilkan karyawan aktif yang nomor HP-nya kosong. Karyawan itu tidak bisa memulihkan akunnya sendiri dan tidak bisa menerima slip gaji lewat WhatsApp. HR memakainya sebagai daftar kerja.

keywords: tanpa whatsapp, nomor wa kosong, no hp kosong, kontak karyawan, nomor telepon karyawan, laporan kontak, lengkapi nomor

steps.en: Open the report. It already lists only active employees without a phone number.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Isinya langsung hanya karyawan aktif tanpa nomor telepon.

steps.en: Search by name or code, or filter by Department or Position.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan nama atau kode, atau saring berdasarkan Department atau Position.

steps.en: Collect the numbers through each department head, then enter them in Master Employee in the field Telepon / WA.
steps.id: Kumpulkan nomor lewat kepala bagian masing-masing, lalu isi di Master Employee pada kolom Telepon / WA.

steps.en: The employee leaves this list once the number is saved.
steps.id: Karyawan hilang dari daftar ini setelah nomornya disimpan.

fields.label: Employee
fields.en: Column: employee name with employee code.
fields.id: Kolom: nama karyawan beserta kode karyawan.

fields.label: Department
fields.en: Column and filter: department of the employee's position.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: departemen dari posisi karyawan.

fields.label: Position
fields.en: Column and filter: position of the employee.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: posisi karyawan.

fields.label: Birth Date
fields.en: Column: birth date, to help identify the person.
fields.id: Kolom: tanggal lahir, untuk membantu mengenali orangnya.

title: Daily Discipline Report

purpose.en: Lists late arrivals, early leaves and absences of the last 31 days. Use it to follow up on employees who are late or absent.
purpose.id: Menampilkan keterlambatan, pulang awal dan ketidakhadiran dalam 31 hari terakhir. Pakai untuk menindaklanjuti karyawan yang terlambat atau tidak masuk.

keywords: kedisiplinan, disiplin, terlambat, telat, alpha, tidak masuk, absen, laporan harian, discipline, pulang awal

steps.en: Open the report. It shows the last 31 days, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Isinya 31 hari terakhir, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: Search by employee or category, or filter by Type (Late or Absent), Category or Department.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan karyawan atau kategori, atau saring berdasarkan Type (Late atau Absent), Category atau Department.

steps.en: Sort by clicking a column heading, for example Late (min), to see the worst cases first.
steps.id: Urutkan dengan mengklik judul kolom, misalnya Late (min), untuk melihat kasus terparah lebih dulu.

steps.en: To correct a wrong status, go to Attendance and use Override Status.
steps.id: Untuk memperbaiki status yang salah, buka Presensi dan pakai Override Status.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Column: attendance date.
fields.id: Kolom: tanggal presensi.

fields.label: Employee
fields.en: Column: employee name and code.
fields.id: Kolom: nama dan kode karyawan.

fields.label: Department
fields.en: Column and filter: department of the employee.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: departemen karyawan.

fields.label: Shift Hours
fields.en: Column: shift start time of that day.
fields.id: Kolom: jam mulai shift pada hari itu.

fields.label: Clock-in Time
fields.en: Column: time the employee clocked in.
fields.id: Kolom: jam karyawan clock-in.

fields.label: Late (min)
fields.en: Column: minutes late.
fields.id: Kolom: jumlah menit terlambat.

fields.label: Category
fields.en: Column and filter: Late under 5, 6-15 or over 15 min, Early leave, Absent without notice, Sick, Permission, Approved permission, Leave or Maternity leave.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: Telat di bawah 5, 6-15 atau di atas 15 menit, Pulang awal, Alpha, Sakit, Izin, Izin disetujui, Cuti atau Cuti melahirkan.

fields.label: Type
fields.en: Column and filter: Late for late arrivals and early leaves, Absent for all absence codes.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: Late untuk terlambat dan pulang awal, Absent untuk semua kode tidak masuk.

title: Portal Sync Log

purpose.en: Troubleshooting log of the candidate portal sync, which pulls new applications into the ERP every 2 minutes. Open it when a candidate says they applied but you cannot find the application.
purpose.id: Log pemecahan masalah sinkronisasi portal kandidat, yang menarik lamaran baru ke ERP tiap 2 menit. Buka bila kandidat bilang sudah melamar tapi lamarannya tidak ditemukan.

keywords: sync log, sinkronisasi, portal kandidat, firebase, mariadb, error sync, submission, rekap sync, lamaran tidak masuk

steps.en: Open the report. Each row is one portal submission pulled by the sync, newest first.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Tiap baris adalah satu kiriman portal yang ditarik sinkronisasi, terbaru di atas.

steps.en: Search by submission ID or error text, or filter by Backend and Result.
steps.id: Cari berdasarkan ID submission atau teks error, atau saring berdasarkan Backend dan Result.

steps.en: A row with result OK created the application; see Application ID. A row with ERROR shows the reason in the Error column.
steps.id: Baris dengan hasil OK sudah membuat lamaran; lihat Application ID. Baris ERROR menampilkan penyebabnya di kolom Error.

steps.en: Group by Date or Result to count problems per day. The report is read-only.
steps.id: Kelompokkan berdasarkan Date atau Result untuk menghitung masalah per hari. Laporan ini hanya-baca.

fields.label: Fetched
fields.en: Column and grouping: date the submission was pulled.
fields.id: Kolom dan grup: tanggal kiriman ditarik.

fields.label: Time
fields.en: Column: time of the pull.
fields.id: Kolom: jam penarikan.

fields.label: Backend
fields.en: Column and filter: which portal database it came from, FIREBASE or MARIADB.
fields.id: Kolom dan filter: database portal asalnya, FIREBASE atau MARIADB.

fields.label: Submission
fields.en: Column: unique ID of the portal submission. The sync uses it to avoid loading the same application twice.
fields.id: Kolom: ID unik kiriman portal. Sinkronisasi memakainya agar lamaran yang sama tidak masuk dua kali.

fields.label: Application ID
fields.en: Column: ID of the application created in the ERP, empty when the pull failed.
fields.id: Kolom: ID lamaran yang dibuat di ERP, kosong bila penarikan gagal.

fields.label: Result
fields.en: Column, filter and grouping: OK when the submission was loaded, ERROR when it failed.
fields.id: Kolom, filter dan grup: OK bila kiriman berhasil dimuat, ERROR bila gagal.

fields.label: Error
fields.en: Column: error message of a failed pull.
fields.id: Kolom: pesan error dari penarikan yang gagal.
